preconditions.description: Number of affected settlements and total settlements within specified bounds.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
preconditions.description: All affected settlements are within the valid range.
Number of affected settlements matches the given count.
Number of paths matches the requirement for a connected graph.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= n and 1 <= bi <= n for ai, bi in paths)
preconditions.description: All path endpoints are within the valid range.

postconditions.description: The number of potential settlements containing the Book of Evil is non-negative.
The number of potential settlements containing the Book of Evil does not exceed the total number of settlements.

postconditions.expression: all(distance(settlement, affected) <= d for settlement in potential_settlements for affected in p)
postconditions.description: All potential settlements are within the damage range of at least one affected settlement.

postconditions.expression: all(any(distance(settlement, affected) <= d for affected in p) for settlement in potential_settlements)
postconditions.description: Each potential settlement is within the damage range of at least one affected settlement.
